image_description: A vintage Panasonic boombox (stereo cassette player) sits on a carpeted floor. To the right of the boombox is a stack of five audio cassettes with handwritten labels such as 'CATS & DOGS', 'RUNNING WALKING', and 'NIGHT LOUNGE'. The cassettes are stacked vertically, showing their spines and front faces.
